name: Audio Manager Pro
headline: Switch your entire audio setup with one key.
description:
Switch your entire Windows audio setup with one key.

Create Audio Profiles for Headset, Speakers, Meeting, Streaming, or VR. One profile can set Windows Default Output, Communications Output, Default Input, and Communications Input together, then optionally restore saved endpoint volume and mute state.

Audio Manager Pro is built for complete setup changes, not per-app mixing. Move from speakers and a desk mic to a headset, switch into a meeting setup, or hand audio over to VR without rebuilding routing one device at a time.

What's Inside: Apply Audio Profile, Set Output Device, Set Input Device, Cycle Audio Profile, Audio Profile Status, Mute Default Mic, and Profile Output Volume for Stream Deck +.

USB, Bluetooth, driver, and Windows changes can recreate audio endpoints. Audio Manager Pro stores stronger Windows device identity where available, safely rebinds when it can, and shows a missing device when it cannot. It never silently picks another device from a weak friendly-name match. Applying a profile reports SUCCESS, PARTIAL, or FAILED.

On Stream Deck +, rotate to adjust the selected profile output volume, press to reapply the profile, and touch to toggle output mute.

Wave Link users can let Monitor Mix follow Windows Default Output while Elgato's Wave Link plugin remains the right tool for Wave-specific routing.

Runs locally on Windows. Requires Windows 10+ and Stream Deck 7.3+.

Part of the Packrat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Add complete user-created Audio Profiles for four Windows audio roles
- Restore saved endpoint volume and mute state per profile
- Add resilient endpoint rebinding with explicit missing-device states
- Add SUCCESS, PARTIAL, and FAILED profile results
- Add Stream Deck + profile-output volume control
- Reuse the shared PackRat Windows Core Audio implementation
